description: A bank's, microfinance bank's or Sacco's M-Pesa paybill. A payee's Bank Account (via Bank Paybill) is paid by B2B to this paybill, with the payee's account number as the reference. M-Pesa Suite ships the top Kenyan institutions; a release updates only the fields you have not changed.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: A short name, e.g. KCB. Letters, digits and dashes.

fields.label: ERPNext Bank
fields.description: Optional: this site's Bank record for the institution. Copied onto payee accounts.

fields.label: Paybill
fields.description: The institution's M-Pesa paybill for deposits to an account. Digits only. Approved accounts keep the number they were approved with: changing it here blocks them until they are approved again.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: new payee accounts cannot pick it. Accounts approved on it are not affected.

fields.label: Account Number Label
fields.description: What the payee account form calls the account number, e.g. Account Number at KCB.

fields.label: Account Number Pattern
fields.description: Optional. A regular expression every account number at this institution must match (spaces and dashes removed first), e.g. \d{13} for 13 digits. Leave empty when the format is not certain.

fields.label: Account Number Rule
fields.description: How the institution wants the account number, shown on the payee account form.

fields.label: Name M-Pesa Shows
fields.description: Exactly as Safaricom shows it after a payment to this paybill, without the number in front, e.g. KCB Paybill AC. Every payment to an account here is checked against it. While empty, only the number is checked.

fields.label: Name M-Pesa Showed Last
fields.description: Kept from a payment while Name M-Pesa Shows is empty. Copy it there once you are sure it is the institution.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where the paybill and the rules come from.

name: M-Pesa Bank Paybill
